name: Company Data API
description: Company data API for Python and the command line: one structured company record from a domain, with name, legal name, description, industry, headquarters, office addresses, emails, phones, social profiles, logo and VAT number, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: profile
commands.help: one company record from a domain
commands.description: One structured company record from a domain: name, description, industry, HQ, socials, contacts, logo.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code — the site is read as a visitor from this country. Default us, in en-US, so a site that localizes by visitor answers in English.

inputs.name: use_ai
inputs.description: Let an LLM fill description, industry, founding year and headquarters from the pages that were read (default on). --no-use-ai returns only the fields read directly from the pages.
